build_warpfieldvae_model: build a WarpFieldVAE model to encode textures and meshes into latent space and decode warped textures
build_deepappearancevae_model: build a DeepAppearanceVAE model to encode textures and meshes and decode predicted textures and meshes
create_warpfielddecoder: create a WarpFieldDecoder to generate spatial warp fields from latent codes and apply them to textures
create_colorcorrection: create a ColorCorrection module to apply per-camera color correction weights and biases to texture tensors
build_spectralnorm_layers: build weight-normalized convolution and linear layers like LinearWN, Conv2dWN, and ConvTranspose2dWN for stable training
